name: Polycab India Ltd
about: Polycab is India’s leading manufacturers of cables and wires and allied products such as uPVC conduits and lugs and glands. We have a range of cables and wires for practically every application.

guidance.extracted_by: Extracted at build time by Claude from the transcript text (the same job llm.extract_guidance does with a key), then checked against the next calls and the reported quarterly numbers. Cached per ticker per quarter.

items.metric: Company EBITDA margin, near to mid term
items.quote: and in the near to mid term, we may expect 12% to 14% EBITDA.
items.actual_quote: EBITDA margins expanded by more than 50 basis points sequentially to 14.4%
items.why: Both quarters since landed in the range, Q2 just above it.

items.quote: we've committed in Cables & Wires, we will grow at 1.5x of market growth.
items.actual: Domestic W&C revenue +50% YoY, volume up mid-to-high single digits in Q2
items.actual_quote: We delivered a volume growth of mid-to high single-digit range on top of a strong base
items.why: Value growth is far ahead, but most of it is copper prices. Volume growth was single digit, so 1.5x the market is unproven this quarter.

items.quote: the ambition is that on a full year basis, we should be able to reach 8% to 10% of EBITDA margins on FMEG.
items.actual_quote: So if you see the 10.1% is already at the upper end of your projected targets.
items.why: One quarter at the top of a 2030 target. Needs a full year at this level to count.

items.quote: in line with our Project Spring guidance of INR 6,000 crores to INR 8,000 crores capex by financial year 2030.
items.actual_quote: FY26, we've invested almost INR 1,500 crores
items.why: ₹1,500 cr a year is the pace the range needs.

items.quote: We remain firm on track to achieve our target of greater than 10% contribution from exports by financial year 2030.
items.why: Long-dated; check the export share each year.

bull.text: Management is delivering: 3 of 4 checkable promises kept or on track
Revenue has compounded 26.9% a year over 5 years
Profits turn into cash: operating cash flow was 100% of PAT over 3 years

items.said: Revenue up 53% on a year ago
items.quote: Consolidated revenue grew by 53% year-on-year, with all business segments contributing meaningfully to this growth momentum.

items.said: EBITDA up 39% on a year ago
items.quote: EBITDA increased by 39% year-on-year, while EBITDA margins expanded by more than 50 basis points sequentially to 14.4%, supported by a favourable business mix and continued focus on operational efficiencies.
Profitability remained robust, with profit after tax reaching a record high of INR 9,900 million, representing a 43% year-over-year increase.

claims.summary: All 3 company-wide figures management read out on the last 2 calls match the reported results.
claims.note: Each figure management read out on the call is recomputed from the quarterly results the company filed, consolidated and standalone, with EBITDA both before and after other income. A figure is only called a mismatch when the call clearly speaks about the whole company.

checks.title: Profit turns into cash
checks.text: Over the last 3 years operating cash flow was 105% of reported profit, so profit is turning into cash.

checks.title: Customers pay on time
checks.text: Customers now take 48 days to pay, against 32 three years ago. Sales may be booked faster than cash is collected.

checks.title: Profit comes from the core business
checks.text: Other income (interest, investment gains, one-offs) was 7% of pre-tax profit in the last 12 months. The core business earns most of the profit.

checks.title: Profit growth backed by operations
checks.text: In FY26, net profit grew 32% while operating profit grew 35%.

checks.title: Tax rate is normal
checks.text: Tax rate in Sep 2026 was 24%, against 25% on average over the four quarters before.

checks.title: No one-off boost this quarter
checks.text: No unusual jump in other income in Sep 2026.

checks.title: Debt under control
checks.text: Debt is 0.02× equity, against 0.02× two years earlier.

checks.title: Promoters are not selling
checks.text: Promoters hold 61.4%, down 0.1 points over the last 4 reported quarters.

quality.summary: 7 of 8 checks are clean; look at: customers pay on time.
